digest.component_or_area: MCP and review-bot service startup and auth binding
propositions: Startup deployment policy and static provider bindings must be composed once at service initialization and remain immutable across subsequent operations
Each operation/request must receive a fresh non-secret OperationSnapshot with live runtime config, while inbound MCP bearer tokens remain request-scoped and never enter snapshots or logs
Decision-bearing auth (Gerrit/GitHub/LLM credentials) must be validated before accepting work, with no principal fallback and only the selected integration constructed
Static binding changes are observed only after process restart; revoked or missing auth fails closed before dedup/clone/provider work begins
Partial or rejected telemetry setup (Langfuse/OTLP) disables telemetry without altering the underlying operation result, while security-critical auth remains fail-closed
